name: Yiff Strip Alchemy (EP8)
source:
Yiff Strip Alchemy is an adult furry puzzle game, where you help Vex make different potions, and in return, she pays you with articles of clothing!

The eighth of a series of games by Furry Outpost. Vex, a witch kobold who is new in town, needs your help coming up with different potions. Invisibility, intangibility, flight, and more, you'll be trying to put together the correct ingredients to make a number of fun combinations!

But hey, even if you get the combinations wrong, you might still find that they have entertaining effects!

[From [url=https://furryoutpost.itch.io/yiff-strip-ep8-alchemy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Yiff Strip Alchemy是一款成人毛茸茸的益智游戏，你可以帮助Vex制作不同的药水，作为回报，她会用衣服来支付给你！

Furry Outpost系列游戏的第八款。韦克斯是新来镇上的狗头人女巫，需要你的帮助来研制不同的药剂。隐形、无形、飞行等等，你将尝试将正确的成分组合在一起，形成许多有趣的组合！

但是，嘿，即使你把组合弄错了，你仍然可能会发现它们有有趣的效果！

[来自[url=https://furryoutpost.itch.io/yiff-strip-ep8-alchemy]itch.io[/url]]
